question: In 1930, ______ established the Depressed Classes Association.
solution:
The correct answer is __**B.R. Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **August 1930**, **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar** established the **Depressed Classes Association** to represent the interests of the **untouchables** and the **oppressed sections** of Indian society.
 
• The primary objective of the association was to demand **political representation** and **social equality** for the **Depressed Classes** within the colonial administrative framework.
 
• During the **First Round Table Conference** in **1930**, **Dr. Ambedkar** used this platform to vigorously advocate for **separate electorates** for the depressed classes, arguing that they needed distinct political safeguards.
 
• This demand for separate electorates later led to a significant ideological conflict with **Mahatma Gandhi**, eventually resulting in the **Poona Pact of 1932**.
